filament_notes:
CC3D TPU 98A 340M, skin colour, 1.75mm. Artillery Genius Pro (DIRECT DRIVE).

Vendor sheet: nozzle 195-215C, bed 0-60C.

Direct drive, so it sits between the Bowden Ender and the H2S: shorter
retraction than the Ender, lower max flow than the H2S. The stock machine
preset retracts 1mm, which is already a direct-drive value.

=== PENDING - fill in after physical calibration ===
nozzle_temperature            215   PENDING  <- temp tower 225-195C / 5C steps
filament_flow_ratio           1.0   PENDING  <- flow tower
filament_max_volumetric_speed 4.0   PENDING  <- expect 3-6 mm3/s on this extruder
filament_retraction_length    1.0   PENDING  <- retraction tower, expect 0.5-1.5mm
pressure advance                    SKIP     <- stock Marlin has LIN_ADVANCE off

Values above are generic/vendor starting points, NOT measured.

filament_density 1.21 g/cm3 is the generic polyester-TPU figure, not a CC3D
published spec. It only scales the 'filament used [g]' estimate.
